title: Hyper Bridgeman
body:
Description

Hyper Bridgeman is removed in version 1.45.6 and has been returned to a new location in version 1.51.0.

He has been moved to the Bridge Brothers Hideout secret room behind the waterfall.

Hyper Bridgeman, the first operator of the bridge from Finlay Island to Ferwater Island. He screams as he talks and needs your help putting down the bridge he watches over and manages.

Trivia

The aforementioned location where Hyper Bridgeman was moved to, as discovered by Robloxian_C8EC, is in the middle-most part near the end of the bridge he used to be stationed at. (He is invisible. Drive slowly to find his dialogue box pop-up.)
